name: Work Residence Permit (employer-sponsored, post-kafala-reform)

requirements.blocker_text: A job offer from a Qatar-based employer willing to sponsor the residence permit.

Job offer must meet Qatar's national minimum wage: QAR 1,000/month base, plus QAR 500 housing and QAR 300 food allowances if not provided in-kind (Law No. 17 of 2020, covers all sectors including domestic workers).

outcome.duration_length: tied to employment contract length; the standard permit duration/renewability cycle was not confirmed on a tier-1 or tier-2 source in this build -- treat as an open gap

sources.title: Government Communications Office (GCO), State of Qatar -- labour reform: exit permits abolished (Jan 2020) for most workers, No Objection Certificate (NOC) to change employer abolished (Aug 2020), non-discriminatory minimum wage of QAR 1,000/month plus QAR 500 housing / QAR 300 food allowances (Law No. 17 of 2020, effective March 2021), Fast-Track Service and Labour Re-employment Platform (2022)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Qatar). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 GCO sourced for the reform-era structure and minimum wage. STRUCTURAL FINDING: Qatar formally dismantled the two defining kafala mechanisms -- the exit permit (2020) and the NOC required to change employer (2020/2021) -- meaning workers can now leave the country and switch jobs without employer consent, a major shift from the pre-reform system modeled implicitly by this dataset's other Gulf-adjacent countries. GAP: standard work-permit duration/renewability terms (commonly cited elsewhere as up to 5 years, tied to contract length) were NOT confirmed on any tier-1/2 source in this build -- only tier-4 visa-agency sites state a specific figure, so no number is asserted here. pr_after_months (240 = 20yr, the 'born outside Qatar' PR threshold) and citizenship_after_months (300 = 25yr) are cross-referenced from qa_permanent_residence.json and qa_citizenship_naturalisation.json respectively, not independently sourced here.
